units.source_text: 特别是时令正值春天，可以看到东山嫩叶的悠悠绿韵。

en.t: Especially with the season just turning to spring, one could see the gentle green charm of the young leaves on Higashiyama.

units.source_text: 晴天还可以远眺叡山 [1] 新叶漫空茏翠。

en.t: On clear days, one could also gaze into the distance at Mount Hiei [1], where the fresh leaves spread through the sky in lush green.
